pharma.title: Non-Scheduled Drug Prices Likely to Increase by Up to 10% from July
pharma.summary: Prices of non-scheduled drugs in India are expected to see an increase of up to 10% starting from July 2026.

pharma.title: India and Netherlands ink pharma-MedTech pact to de-risk global supply chains
pharma.summary: India and the Netherlands signed a pharmaceutical and MedTech agreement aimed at de-risking global supply chains.

pharma.title: Roche launches 7-minute cancer shot in India
pharma.summary: Pharmaceutical major Roche has introduced a 7-minute cancer injection treatment in India.

national.title: CIC rules BCCI outside RTI ambit, reverses 2018 order
national.summary: The Central Information Commission (CIC) ruled that the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) does not fall under the purview of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, reversing its earlier 2018 ruling.

national.title: Andhra Pradesh government advocates larger family sizes
national.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government led by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has encouraged couples to have 3 to 4 children to address demographic concerns.

international.title: 79th World Health Assembly opening remarks delivered by WHO Director-General
international.summary: The Director-General of the World Health Organization delivered the opening address at the high-level welcome for the 79th World Health Assembly.

international.title: Housing crisis takes centre stage at World Urban Forum in Baku
international.summary: The global housing crisis emerged as a primary focus at the United Nations World Urban Forum held in Baku.

international.title: India rejects Dutch concerns on minority rights
international.summary: New Delhi officially rejected concerns raised by the Netherlands regarding minority rights in India.

economy.title: PM Modi woos Swedish firms to invest in India
economy.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi invited Swedish businesses to invest in India, emphasizing fast-tracked economic reforms across sectors.

economy.title: Govt directs state-run banks, insurance firms to cut costs, shift to EVs
economy.summary: The Union Government directed public sector banks and state-owned insurance enterprises to adopt cost-cutting measures and transition their vehicle fleets to electric vehicles.

economy.title: India set to lead global AI economy, says Home Minister
economy.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that India is well-positioned to assume a leadership role in the global artificial intelligence economy.

science.title: Tata-ASML deal to boost India’s semiconductor push
science.summary: Tata partnered with Dutch tech firm ASML to strengthen domestic semiconductor manufacturing capability in India.

science.title: India Explores Private Investment Opportunities in Nuclear Sector
science.summary: Indian authorities held talks with a visiting US industry delegation to explore private investment opportunities in the domestic nuclear energy sector.

science.title: India puts transport hubs on alert following WHO Ebola emergency declaration
science.summary: Following WHO's declaration of a global emergency over an Ebola outbreak, Indian authorities put airports and seaports on high alert, confirming no cases have been detected in India.

environment.title: Health risks from climate change spur stronger public support for action
environment.summary: Research findings show that rising health risks linked to climate change are generating increased public support for environmental policy action.

environment.title: Women highlighted as key stakeholders in environmental governance
environment.summary: Recent environmental policy discussions emphasized the critical role of women in sustainable resource governance and decision-making.

environment.title: Improvement in India-China ties to support climate policy
environment.summary: A study by the Centre for Social and Economic Progress (CSEP) indicates that easing diplomatic tensions between India and China could benefit global climate change mitigation.

sports.title: Karman Kaur Thandi secures spot in French Open singles qualifying draw
sports.summary: Indian tennis player Karman Kaur Thandi secured a place in the qualifying draw for the French Open women's singles event.

awards_honours.title: PM Modi Conferred With Grand Cross Of Royal Norwegian Order Of Merit
awards_honours.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was awarded Norway's highest civilian honour, the Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit, representing his 32nd international award.

defence.title: India, Sweden agree to elevate bilateral ties to 'strategic partnership'
defence.summary: India and Sweden officially agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a strategic partnership spanning technology, trade, and defence.

defence.title: India condemns attack on UAE's Barakah nuclear plant
defence.summary: India strongly condemned a military attack targeting the Barakah nuclear power plant located in the United Arab Emirates.

defence.title: Pakistan deploys 8,000 troops and fighter jets to Saudi Arabia
defence.summary: Pakistan deployed 8,000 troops and fighter jets to Saudi Arabia under a bilateral defence treaty amid growing regional conflict.

schemes_appointments.title: Amit Shah launches first public service centre inside Chhattisgarh security camp
schemes_appointments.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the first public service centre established inside a security camp in Chhattisgarh to improve citizen services in post-Naxal regions.

schemes_appointments.title: Bengal govt launches Rs 3,000 Annapurna aid scheme
schemes_appointments.summary: The West Bengal government introduced the Rs 3,000 Annapurna assistance scheme while ending religious honorarium programs.

schemes_appointments.title: Karnataka launches ‘Bhoo Guarantee’ scheme for property regularisation
schemes_appointments.summary: Karnataka launched the 'Bhoo Guarantee' scheme to regularize approximately 7 lakh unregistered or disputed properties at a 2% fee.

schemes_appointments.title: Dr Vedprakash Mishra Appointed Head of NMC National Experts Panel
schemes_appointments.summary: Dr. Vedprakash Mishra was appointed as the head of the National Medical Commission (NMC) National Experts Panel.

important_days.title: FAO unveils International Day of Potato 2026 theme
important_days.summary: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) announced the official theme for the International Day of Potato 2026, focusing on farmers' livelihoods.

important_days.title: GPMC Announces World Pest Day 2026 Theme
important_days.summary: The Global Pest Management Coalition (GPMC) announced the official theme for World Pest Day 2026.

mcqs.explanation: India and the Netherlands signed a pharma-MedTech agreement on 18 May 2026 aimed at de-risking global supply chains.
